# Itatest Biology — publication content handoff v1

Content only; no app, database or importer changes. Preserve the five original chapters, 41 full teaching lessons (including worked examples), 30 restored original SVG illustrations, 371 revised legacy practice MCQs, 356 legacy exercises linked to those MCQs, 25 newly authored open-response exercises and 50 new MCQs in five ten-question mock exams. Five chapter review tests reference existing practice questions; do not count these as additional distinct questions. All 421 MCQs have five options and answer explanations. Existing chapter, topic, lesson, question and linked exercise identifiers are preserved. New IDs are deterministic. Seven supplemental R1/R2 sections are mapped into related lessons through the scientific clarifications; 44 noncanonical source sections and the original main lesson records are retained under provenance.

## Canonical delivery files

- `chapters/01`–`05`: chapter, topics, lessons, questions, exercises JSON. HTML is the canonical teaching representation; HTML and Markdown files are alternate reading views, not duplicate lesson records. Each lesson links to question and exercise IDs. Legacy embedded practice blocks are removed from the teaching HTML to avoid displaying obsolete four-option keys.
- `mock-questions.json` / `assessments.json`: distinct original mock questions and exam membership. Mock duration 20 minutes, 10 questions; +1 correct, −0.25 incorrect, 0 unanswered. Raw practice score only, not an official normalized score. Questions are authored Itatest items, not official CISIA questions.
- `mock-exams.md` / `mock-answers.md`: separate manual examination and answer-key views.
- `curriculum-map.md` / `quick-review.md`: current official syllabus mapping and review notes.
- `figures/`: original vectors restored from the source HTML, also embedded in lesson HTML. Verify SVG IDs, responsive sizes, contrast and RTL/LTR layout in the actual site.
- `provenance/`: archival source records and mapping; never publish them or obsolete answer keys as active lessons. Preserve the original records for rollback. Avoid choosing multiple closely related variants in one assessment. Original source metadata may contain local paths; it is for internal use only.

## Editorial decisions and limitations

The full pre-existing Persian lessons are retained, with 41 lesson-specific scientific clarifications, selected direct text corrections, and supplementary plastid/bacterial-division explanations. The official five biology nuclei have mapped lesson locations. Supporting topics such as biotechnology, ecology models, immunity and endocrine physiology are retained but are not presented as explicit syllabus requirements. Legacy questions were reviewed at stem/key level, 350 fourth-option banks expanded to five options (one new distractor each), selected stems/answers/rationales corrected and option order shuffled. The new distractors and old rationales need independent specialist verification for semantic ambiguity and completeness; legacy explanations do not always discuss the new option, and some source lessons may still contain simplifications or conflicting passages. New questions and exercises were authored for this handoff. This is not a claim of complete independent line-by-line scientific verification. Difficulty tags and relative question distribution are not calibrated. Structural validation checks counts, unique IDs, five distinct option strings, zero-based key alignment, lesson references and assessment membership; it does not prove scientific correctness. The package is suitable as content for Codex to integrate, but production import/rendering and expert scientific sign-off have not been performed. Never expose keys or solutions in unanswered assessment payloads. Treat open-response exercises as ungraded/self-check unless a scoring rubric is implemented. 

Official scope: https://cisiaonline.it/en/cent/cent-s/structure-and-syllabus (accessed 2026-11-24).

# Itatest Chemistry — publication content handoff (v3)

**Scope:** educational content only. No database, import code, backend, frontend or deployment changes. All 50 canonical lessons contain Persian teaching text, English exam terms, worked examples, common traps and independent exercises. All MCQs have five English options and Persian explanations. New content is original Itatest practice, not official CISIA questions.

## What to import
- `chapters/01` through `chapters/10`: chapter.json, lessons.json, questions.json, exercises.json. JSON is canonical; Markdown is a human-readable view. The `Html` field contains semantic HTML and inline SVG when appropriate. `Text` and `Markdown` are alternate content views, not additional lessons.
- `assessments.json` and `mock-questions.json`: ten chapter reviews reuse practice questions intentionally; five 10-question/20-minute chemistry mocks use a separate item set. Keep mock answers out of learner-facing question payloads until grading. Raw practice scoring is not CISIA normalisation.
- `figures/`: original standalone SVG teaching figures. The same visuals are embedded in canonical lesson HTML. No external assets needed for these figures.
- `provenance/section-mapping.json` and `question-mapping.json`: use these to reconcile legacy IDs with the new hierarchy. The old section archive contains superseded language and must NOT be published or imported as live lessons. All 81 original question IDs, 10 previous addition IDs and 66 linked exercise IDs are retained. New chapter/lesson IDs are deterministic. Old section IDs are mapped, not silently reused for different content. Linked exercise records are aliases of bank questions, not additional independent items.

## Editorial and delivery boundaries
The prior export was consulted and the complete lesson set was rewritten; R1/R2 summaries are incorporated by topic. Some original examples and figures are archived rather than reproduced verbatim. The new material includes a few supporting introductory concepts beyond the literal syllabus (e.g. empirical formula, formal charge, electrochemical cell calculations and atom economy); the curriculum map identifies the required coverage. Difficulty labels are editorial estimates, not empirical item calibration. Structural checks were run; this is not an independent review by a chemistry specialist and no live rendering, production import, entitlement or assessment behaviour was tested. The content is complete as an authored handoff, not a guarantee of error-free publication. Codex should map the schema, validate rendering and ensure the superseded content is no longer served; a subject expert should review before charging students.

## Sources and date
CISIA CEnT-S structure and syllabus, accessed 2026-11-24: https://www.cisiaonline.it/en/cent/cent-s/structure-and-syllabus
CISIA rules: https://www.cisiaonline.it/en/cent/all-about-CEnT/CEnT-rules
General chemistry reference for further independent review: OpenStax Chemistry 2e, https://openstax.org/details/books/chemistry-2e (not a claim that every line was independently source-checked).

# Itatest — Reasoning on texts and data / targeted content revision

Content only. Source: provided content export (local preview). Existing chapter order and IDs preserved. 178 lesson sections, 79 questions, 76 exercises, plus 15 original five-option mock items and a supplementary lesson.

`patches.json` lists targeted before/after field changes for 27 records. `subjects/logic` contains updated record JSON and existing chapter materials. `database-sources/logic` contains source HTML snapshots with targeted edits; original SHA metadata is historical, not the checksum of revised content. Source Markdown snapshots under database-sources are historical; use revised lesson-section JSON as canonical. Other metadata, document records and frontend samples are retained reference material, not replacement data. `new-mock-questions.json` is a separate content schema for Codex mapping; 0-based answers. Do not import as an existing database row schema without adapting. `supplemental-lesson.md` is original supplemental content.

The quarantined exercise remains quarantined until explicit editorial approval; its visible lesson wording/solution and candidate record are corrected. Do not silently activate it or duplicate it with an existing test. Keep the existing four-option practice items; the new mock matches 15-question/30-minute format.

Verification: source IDs and option/key consistency verified for every original question/exercise; mock unique IDs and options checked. This is targeted review, not certification of every lesson, embedded example, figure or historical source. HTML display and database integration not tested. No code or database changed.

packages.readme:
# Itatest Mathematics — minimal correction package

Purpose: preserve existing teaching material, chapter sequence, visual assets, questions, exercises, and identity keys; change only specific documented issues. No new syllabus structure or question bank was imposed.

## Integration handoff
- `patches.json` is authoritative: each row identifies the original record by Id and ImportKey and contains exact before/after values of changed fields. Apply by matching ID and expected old field; abort/report conflicts, and do not apply twice. For source-derived records, also port the corresponding localized corrections into the canonical source/seed HTML so a subsequent import cannot overwrite them. Raw source documents included under `database-sources/math/` are untouched historical references, NOT replacement import payloads. Likewise `frontend-samples` and source-document metadata are references, not new production content. Do not import the entire archive blindly.
- `subjects/math/` contains the corrected export in its original organization, including source-wide sections. JSON records are authoritative; Markdown is for review. Original answer keys, options, IDs, topic relationships, ordering and all other record fields are unchanged.
- `validation.json` records structural checks. No database or application code has been modified.
- Existing four-option practice questions are deliberately retained (174 of 201). The official examination uses five choices; do not represent these practice items as exact-format mock exams. No new mock exam is included in this minimal-change package.
- Scientific review: all 201 existing MCQ stems/answer keys were inspected; 27 generic explanations were made question-specific. Selected lesson passages and open-response items were checked and corrected; no exhaustive line-by-line certification of all 89 sections and 204 exercises is claimed. No independent specialist or browser test was performed.

# Itatest Physics — publication content handoff (v1)

Educational content only. The six existing main chapters and 68 full lessons are preserved and revised, rather than replaced by shorter summaries. The official fluid/thermodynamics nucleus is split into two teaching chapters. R1/R2 concepts are merged into the corresponding lessons; the superseded material is archived separately. The original 99 source sections, 220 questions and 97 source exercises are preserved in provenance.

## Canonical files
- `chapters/01`–`06`: `chapter.json`, `lessons.json`, `questions.json`, `exercises.json`. Lesson HTML is the delivery content; standalone HTML and Markdown are alternate views, not additional lessons. Existing lesson and topic IDs are preserved. Existing question IDs are preserved, but answer indexes may change because choices were revised and deterministically shuffled. All indexes are zero-based. The `correctOptionText` and `Explanation` fields are for grading/review, not ungraded learner payloads.
- 256 practice MCQs (220 revised existing questions plus 36 new original questions); 25 separate mock MCQs; 30 independent open-response exercises. 97 original exercises are linked aliases of MCQs, not 97 additional independent questions.
- `assessments.json`: six ten-question chapter reviews and five five-question, ten-minute practice mocks. Raw scoring is +1 correct, −0.25 wrong, 0 unanswered; these are not CISIA normalised scores. Mock questions are original Itatest practice, not official CISIA items.
- `figures/`: 51 restored SVG figures from the original authored source; inline SVG is also embedded in canonical lessons. Preserve vector rendering, RTL text and LTR formulas. SVG and layout still need site-side verification.
- `formula-sheet.md`, `curriculum-map.md`: formula reference and coverage mapping.
- `provenance/`: original records, editorial change/mapping files, near-duplicate variant groups. Do not publish archived lesson HTML or old answers. When selecting assessment questions, avoid selecting multiple members of a variant group; retain source-linked exercises as references rather than duplicate questions.

## Editorial and delivery boundaries
Source content was inspected; all 220 original MCQ answers were recalculated or conceptually reviewed, with Persian explanations, extra distractors, and explicit assumptions where needed. Existing four-option questions now have five options. Some generated numerical distractors were replaced with meaningful magnitude errors. The full existing teaching content and figures have not undergone independent line-by-line expert verification; 23 direct paragraph edits and targeted clarifications address identified overgeneralisations and syllabus gaps. Some legacy near-duplicate items remain intentionally as practice variants. Source-wide summaries/practice are archived; the canonical formula sheet and tests replace them. The chapter arrangement preserves supporting material beyond the syllabus. Question difficulty labels are editorial and uncalibrated.

No database, importer, application code or deployment changes were performed. The package is an authored content handoff for Codex to integrate and validate; independent physics-specialist review and real website rendering/import checks are still needed before commercial release. Do not infer those checks from structural validation.

Official syllabus (accessed 2026-11-24): https://cisiaonline.it/en/cent/cent-s/structure-and-syllabus

# Itatest Reading and Comprehension — reviewed content v1

Content-only handoff for Codex. No application code, database migrations, credentials or user data. Original lesson order, topic IDs, section IDs, question IDs and exercise IDs remain unchanged. The input was the local export, not production.

## Apply
- `subjects/reading/`: reviewed copies of existing content; two original question stems and two lesson examples were corrected. Existing question keys were retained. `patches.json` lists precise field-level changes. Treat original `_source` metadata and SHA values as historical provenance, not as updated hashes.
- `database-sources/reading/`: matching reviewed source HTML and Markdown. Do not reimport these as extra chapters. Regenerate source metadata and any derived documents from the selected reviewed sources in the target environment.
- `existing-passages-canonical.json`: five distinct existing passages with original question-group references. The R1 historical snapshots duplicate three of the R2 passages; do not import both releases as distinct active content. Original exercise records duplicate the 33 original questions and must not be counted twice.
- `new-passages.json`, `new-questions.json`, `mock-exams.json`: 10 additional original passages, 50 new five-option questions, and five 10-question / 30-minute practice exams. New UUIDs are deterministic; question keys and group relationships are explicit. Questions carry existing skill/topic associations; new content source keys are proposed and Codex must map them to the application schema. No new exercises are implied by the mock questions.
- `mock-exams.md` / `.html`: student-facing preview without keys; `mock-answers.md`: separate instructor/feedback answers. Do not expose answer keys during timed attempts.
- `curriculum-map.md`: official syllabus comparison and genre limitations. `validation.json`: structural validation results.

## Review status
All 33 original question stems, choices and keys were compared against their passage or short excerpt. Two stems were clarified without changing keys. The 10 existing lesson sections were read; two generic repeated examples replaced. The new passages and questions were authored for training, with Persian explanations. All 83 unique questions have five distinct options and consistent zero-based answers. Each mock has two passages and 10 unique questions, with two answers per option letter. This is an editorial design choice, not a CISIA specification. The passages are original simulations targeting B2; no independent specialist review, CEFR calibration, live import or frontend test has been performed. They are not official CISIA questions or authentic published excerpts.
